definition.description: The grade of peripheral neuropathy, representing the severity of nerve damage often induced by chemotherapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical grade of peripheral neuropathy (e.g., 'Grade 1', '2/4') from the oncology assessment, progress notes, or patient-reported outcome tools such as PRO-CTCAE. If only a descriptive term is provided (e.g., 'Mild', 'Moderate', 'Severe') and mapped to a grade in the same note, extract the numeric grade.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing, not mentioned, or ambiguous grade documentation as null.
definition.name: peripheral_neuropathy_grade

definition.description: Presence of edema surrounding the tumor as identified on radiographic imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment imaging records explicitly state the presence or absence of peritumoral (surrounding) edema.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if edema is not mentioned or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: peritumoral_edema

definition.description: Presence of abnormal signal intensity in the white matter surrounding the cerebral ventricles on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of 'periventricular signal abnormality' or 'periventricular white matter signal changes' from the radiology findings or impression.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the radiology report does not mention periventricular signal intensity or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: periventricular_signal_abnormality

definition.description: Phosphorylation status of the MET receptor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported status of phospho-MET (p-MET) from pathology or molecular pathology reports, typically recorded as positive or negative.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if phospho-MET status is not documented, not tested, or reported ambiguously.
definition.name: phospho_met_status

definition.description: Presence of PI3K pathway activation, typically identified through molecular profiling of the PIK3CA gene.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of PI3K pathway activation from molecular pathology or Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) reports. The feature is 'Activated' if the report identifies activating mutations in PIK3CA (e.g., H1047R, E545K) or explicitly states 'PI3K pathway activation'. The feature is 'Not Activated' if the report explicitly states that no activating PIK3CA mutations were detected or that the pathway is not activated.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the PI3K pathway status is not documented or the report is ambiguous.
definition.name: pi3k_pathway_activation

definition.description: Presence of abnormal enhancement in the pituitary gland on post-contrast imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the radiology report describes 'abnormal enhancement' within the pituitary gland. If the report states 'no abnormal enhancement' or describes only normal physiological enhancement, the value is 'Absent'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the pituitary gland is not mentioned or if the enhancement status is not documented.
definition.name: pituitary_gland_enhancement

definition.description: Assessment of the signal intensity of the pituitary gland as observed on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the radiologist's description of the pituitary gland signal from the imaging report. Categorize as 'Normal' if the report states the signal is normal or if there is no abnormal enhancement/signal identified. Categorize as 'Abnormal' if any abnormal signal intensity, abnormal enhancement, or pathology is noted within the pituitary gland.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the pituitary gland signal is not mentioned or the documentation is insufficient to determine normality.
definition.name: pituitary_gland_signal

definition.description: The size of the pituitary gland, typically measured as the maximum craniocaudal height.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the maximum height of the pituitary gland in millimeters. If a numerical measurement is unavailable but the gland is described as 'normal size', this qualitative assessment should be preserved as a fallback.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the pituitary gland size is not mentioned or cannot be determined from the record.
definition.name: pituitary_gland_size

definition.description: the number of platelets per microliter of blood, reported in thousands (k/uL)
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for platelets (Plt) from the Complete Blood Count (CBC) in the pretreatment record. Report the value in thousands per microliter (k/uL); for example, if the value is 210,000/uL, extract 210.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the platelet count is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: platelet_count

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
